text:
We’ve confirmed that Anselm Reyes has taken over as conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, effective 1 October after the board’s vote at its 14 September technical session in Bracken Hall. Reyes, previously associate conductor at the Lydon Civic Orchestra, will lead the ensemble through its 2026 renewal cycle and a scheduled 18-concert regional run.

- Appointment confirmed by the Philharmonic board on 14 September
- Contract term: three seasons, with an optional fourth year
- First rehearsal under Reyes set for 6 October
- Opening program to feature Caldor, Venn, and a new commission by Mira Solis
- Orchestra staffing remains unchanged; section leads will report directly to Reyes
- Budget for the launch season: 2.4 million halens
